notes.title: A Small Paint Tool Update
notes.notes:
A small change arrives today — no incremental patch version. 

Rebel Galaxy Outlaw Release version 1.18d

[b]ART[/b]
*The masks for painting the Mattock, Foxbat, and SPZ went on vacation.  We found them and put them back where they belong.

To access these masks, please close and update Rebel Galaxy Outlaw via Steam.

notes.title: Patch 1.18D Has Arrived!
notes.notes:
Another incremental patch surrounding achievements.  We hope you're all enjoying the Steam version!

[u][b]Rebel Galaxy Outlaw Release version 1.18d[/b][/u]

[b]BUGS[/b]
*The "Wolfpack" achievement now always triggers correctly.  For anyone who missed this achievement, it will now pop the first time a save is loaded, providing the save has all six buddies unlocked.

notes.title: Patch 1.18C Has Arrived!
notes.notes:
Hello space pilots! The day after launch brings us a small patch.  We hope you're all enjoying the newly arrived Steam version!

[u][b]Rebel Galaxy Outlaw Release version 1.18B[/b][/u]

[b]BUGS[/b]
*The "On The Road" achievement will now trigger correctly.  For anyone who missed this achievement, it will now pop the first time Juno moves through any jumpgate.

*Incremental achievements such as "Kill 1 Pirate Lord" - "Kill 5 Pirate Lords" - etc, will now trigger correctly.  Note for those who have already triggered these achievements, you get to keep them.

notes.title: Patch 1.18B Has Arrived!
notes.notes:
Hello space pilots! Launch day brings us a small patch.  We hope you’re all enjoying the newly arrived Steam version

[u][b]Rebel Galaxy Outlaw Release version 1.18[/b][/u]

[b]OPTIMIZATIONS[/b]
*The game was not yet available on Steam.  Now it is!  Hurray!

[u][b]Rebel Galaxy Outlaw Release version 1.18B[/b][/u]

[b]BUGS[/b]
*Fixed an issue in flight training where cycling stations from the map mode could result in a crash.

notes.title: Space sim Rebel Galaxy Outlaw launches on Steam in September
notes.notes:
Space cowboy trucker simulation Rebel Galaxy Outlaw has been off the radar for a bit but they’ve blipped back into existence. Strap into the cockpit and get ready for some more hauls. Double Damage Games have announced that the game will be launching on Steam and consoles on September 22nd.
